newsitem.title: FRANCE: French govt wants euro launched on time - Jospin.
newsitem.headline: French govt wants euro launched on time - Jospin.

text.p: The French government wants the single European currency to be launched on time, but the project must be based on more than monetary considerations, French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said on Friday.
"The government favours a single currency, and favours the launch of this currency at the scheduled date," Jospin told a news conference after a Franco-German summit in this French city.

"Other considerations exist. The French government's approach consists of saying that ... these considerations touching on jobs, growth and economic cooperation are equally very important," Jospin said.

He said his government's proposals add a new dimension to European economic and monetary union "in addition to those elements to which we are attached such as monetary stability, control of public spending and payroll charges ... to launch a single currency on time under the right conditions".
